caveats: Standalone sandbox size, concurrency, hourly or fixed runtime fee and tax treatment not confirmed in first-party pricing.
Credits have a monetary conversion but this does not verify how many credits hosting costs.
No arbitrary 4/8 machine or eight-hour session eligibility established.
Unknowns remain null, not free; generic infrastructure modes are opt-in alt.
Worked example assumes resources are released between active windows unless a retained-instance scenario is explicitly discussed.
VAT basis: Unknown: reviewed pricing source does not explicitly establish VAT/tax inclusion.
Residency: International minimax.io and China minimaxi.com are separate sites; actual sandbox hosting country and region pinning not verified.

No first-party sandbox/VM/compute price exists as of 2026-09-29: the developer platform prices only model/media APIs (pay-as-you-go per token/call; Server Tools beta web_search $0.01/request) and Token Plan subscriptions; hosted agents (MaxClaw 'running 24/7 in the cloud', MaxHermes beta, MiniMax Code desktop-to-cloud handoff) are consumer products paid from Token Plan quota/credits, with plan prices shown only inside the signed-in app (agent.minimax.io/pricing renders the home page for logged-out users).

Token Plan (model subscription, not compute): Plus $22/month, Max $55/month, Ultra $132/month with 5-hour rolling and weekly quota windows; Credits 1,000 = $1 in $5/$25/$100 packs valid 365 days; Token Plan for Teams closed to new purchases from 2026-09-05.
Token Plan for Teams: 'New purchases of Token Plan for Teams will be suspended starting September 5, 2026.'

eu_data_residency.quote: Your personal data described in this Policy are stored in the data center located in the United States and processed by us or third-party vendors in accordance with the requirements of relevant laws and regulations, including the GDPR.
eu_data_residency.note: The privacy policy states all user data is stored in a US data center (cross-border transfer to the EU-US Privacy Framework/SCCs for EU users), with no option to pin data/machines to an EU region.
